questions.scope: Recognized amphibian groups and species count, living or extinct. Common names and scientific names count. Fish, reptiles, and aquatic mammals are not amphibians merely because they live in water.

Named mollusc groups and species count, including gastropods, bivalves, cephalopods, chitons and other mollusc lineages. Common and scientific names count. Crustaceans, echinoderms and cnidarians do not count.

Named crustacean groups, species and recognized common kinds count, aquatic or terrestrial. Common and scientific names count. Horseshoe crabs are chelicerates, not crustaceans; molluscs and other arthropod groups are outside this question.

Named arachnid groups, species and recognized common kinds count. Spiders, scorpions, ticks, mites, harvestmen and other arachnid orders are included. Insects, crustaceans and myriapods are outside this question.

questions.scope: Recognized sciences and academic research fields count, including mathematics, social sciences, linguistics, medicine and engineering. Subdisciplines and documented historical names count. A result, isolated technique or pseudoscientific practice is not itself an academic discipline.
